review_description: Getting solar installed by MDB Solar was seamless and smooth. Marco walked me through the whole thing with the calm confidence and professionalism with an old school touch.Bianca kept the comms sharp and stress-free, no chasing, no guessing and even followed up when we had issues that we didn’t even know about.The install team were fast, tidy and respectful of our home like a crew that’s been doing this since before solar was cool.The pricing was unbeatable considering the amount of service you get fromIf you want solar done right, with the old school touch and new school tech, MDB Solar is the move.I would highly recommend them to anyone wanting solar.

After obtaining various quotes, we found MDB solar to be the most value for money without compromising quality. The process was very professional from our initial contact with Adrian who work out our needs and also considered our future usage, to the efficient installation from Domenic and the team and also a follow-up from Marco to ensure everything was to our expectation and satisfaction.

Great install, very neat, tidy and professional. Communication was excellent all through the process and they were punctual on the day with a text notification before they arrived. I am also very pleased with the design layout on the roof too. All in all I am very happy with the end result and would recommend them to family and friends.

Obtaining written quote was easy and quick, good advice given on options and configuration and quote was clear.  Installation set up around our availability and team arrived when they said they would. Conditions on the day were rainy and cold but guys worked through and got the system installed and configured in one day.  Very happy with the performance of the system and the associated app which lets us monitor and control.

2nd time using MDB Solar - first time was getting our solar system installed a few years ago.This time was a battery.Both times the communication before + install team have been very easy to deal with and made sure everything was setup right.Will be using them again in the future if I need to do anything else solar/battery related.

Reliable honest company to deal with.Visited my home pre quotation to view location of installation of new battery and also electrical upgrades by company technicians.Quote was very competitive and after discussing with the Owner Marco i was very comfortable to go ahead with the installation.Quality of product and workmanship was excellent.Installers were employees of MDB Solar and not subcontractors was another selling feature

Marco and his team installed a 12.76 KW system with 25kw Sungrow batteries with Jinko panels to my house. We thoroughly recommend MBS solar, Marco 's communication was so good. Marco organised everything in regards to my installation. I always felt comfortable with the lead times of installation. Quality of the work was excellent, installation was done in one day. System working straight away, no issues at all. We are so happy. Thank you Marco and MBD solar  team

Extremely happy that we chose MDB Solar to replace our old solar system with a new solar system & battery. Marco & Bianca were friendly & helpful during the quoting process & in organising the timing of the installation after we decided to accept their quote. The installation was well organised & Domenic & the team were punctual, polite, professional & friendly. The system was neatly installed, the site tidied & a visual explanation of the various components & changes to the electrical switchboard was given. After sales service has also been excellent in following up the battery rebate & providing an extensive user manual. The new solar system has been working for about 2 months & the battery for nearly a month & are going really well. We have no hesitation in recommending MDB Solar.

I have nothing but positives to say about my experience with MDB Solar. Marco was both helpful and informative with any queries I had regarding my solar/battery selection. His no pressure attitude made dealing with him a delight. I also found the installation team that worked on my job to be friendly, polite, and professional, and most importantly, they did a great job. Thanks, Marco and team.

I went with MDB Solar because they didn’t overwhelm me with a sales pitch. Their quote was not the lowest or the highest and after doing some research, I found their panels and inverter to be mid range good quality. Marco was very helpful with any questions and was happy to listen to my enquires about my meters to make them safe in an affordable way unlike others who used scare tactics to make you spend a thousand or more on top of the solar. The installation guys were great, arrived when they said and all went smoothly. Looking forward to seeing the savings. I recommend MDB Solar.

Total professional quality company to deal with! The MDB team were so easy to deal with, the trades were precise and the system is amazing! It's was so easy to deal with MDB from the initial decision to go down the solar path! Thank you again MDB solar
Fantastic to deal with from start to finish,Install was quick and easy with no issues, installers were polite, punctual and left everywhere clean and tidy, everything was set up ready to go.
Quote provides by email2 days installationGood customer serviceNice solar panel

No problems at all; good customer service from start to end and the crew that did the install were professional. MDB were happy to answer all my questions and the level of communication was excellent.

MDB was one of the 3 solar installers recommended through SolarQuotes. At first, we were a little hesitant. We wanted to support a small local business but they had less reviews than the others. However, they offered a really good system (one we were hoping for) for a competitive price and Marco (the owner) came across as genuine and professional during my interactions with him.It was the best decision and we have been so pleased with Marco and his team from first contact to installation. There was no pressure or hard sell tactics. Marco was easy to contact when we had questions. Professional and efficient from start to finish, they made the whole process easy, smooth and straightforward.Marco sent a quote after a conversation on the phone where I gave him details about my home. After informing him that we wanted to go ahead (pre-deposit), he sent his team to check our home, roof and electrical set up. Then, he gave us detailed information about how our solar system will be set up (there were a few complications and limitations due to the age and layout of our block of units) before we set the installation date and paid the deposit. On the day of installation, Marco’s team were friendly, punctual, hardworking and efficient. No roof tiles were damaged or broken, which was a bonus. One of the electricians helped me install the app and showed me the system after.Thank you to Marco and the team at MDB. It was a great experience all round and we would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone who asks.

Marco and his team have been wonderful from start to finish. They have shown professionalism and great service and was always happy to answer any questions I had. The price of the solar was good value too. The installation was a smooth process and they left the place all nice and tidy. I would highly recommend them.
Quick return of quote. Explained what we needed. Date booked in and Installers arrived on time. Friendly and very efficient. Showed how to turn on and linked to App. Would definitely recommend.

Marco was prompt to come out and provide a quote. He was happy to alter and customise the package to suit our preferences.The office communicated well with the admin side of things and one of the tradesman kindly ran us through using the inverter app.Our place was left tidy after the installation and it was completed as scheduled.

Marco was awesome to chat with and explained everything very well to me, from inverter brands through to sizing and position on my house.The 2 lads who did install were very efficient and quick.The whole process was very smooth sailing and I would recommend MDB Electrical to anyone who is looking.
